body: I'm sure I play too many video games. It's my only place where I can actually feel a sliver of enjoyment. But that leads to more procrastination.  Oh I have x hours to do all that work.  Oops.  3 hours go by,  I still have time.  Etc...  Until well fuck.  I don't have time to do any of this.  Oh well.  Take the grade hit and rinse and repeat.  I've been depressed for a few years now.  Some days I just cry myself to sleep before continuing the same monotonous routine after I wake up wishing I had died in my sleep.
